svg.title: How Smart Home for AgentBuff is built
svg.desc: People: Home owner, AI agent. App: Web app, MCP server. Services: Worker, AgentBuff login. Data & cloud: PostgreSQL, Tuya cloud. Docker Compose on a VPS: database, web and worker on an internal network, with backups and a row-level security test at each deploy.
svg.text: The main parts and how data moves between them.
Docker Compose on a VPS: database, web and worker on an internal network, with backups and a row-level security test at each deploy.
